features.name: heavy_halogen_count
features.description: Sum of heavy halogen-like substructure counts (V3 Cl-like, V4 Br-like, V11 F-like) often resistant to biodegradation.
features.expected_model_benefit: Tree splits on cumulative halogenation can separate persistent compounds.

features.name: aromatic_ring_intensity
features.description: Composite index of aromatic/ring descriptors combining V16 and V41 counts with V8 percent property.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures aromatic load which strongly affects biodegradability.

features.name: nitrogen_oxygen_functional_sum
features.description: Total count of N/O containing functional group descriptors (V5,V6,V7,V9,V10).
features.expected_model_benefit: Polar functional group load is a strong determinant of biodegradation pathways.

features.name: has_any_rare_substructure
features.description: Boolean indicator: presence of any rare substructure flags V19, V24, V29.
features.expected_model_benefit: Single split captures presence of unusual moieties.

features.name: molecular_size_bucket
features.description: Ordinal bucket of V39 (molecular size descriptor): 0 small, 1 medium, 2 large, 3 very large.
features.expected_model_benefit: Discrete size tier for tree thresholds.

features.name: lipophilicity_proxy
features.description: Proxy for lipophilicity combining V1 and V13 (log-like descriptors) minus polar V12.
features.expected_model_benefit: Lipophilic vs hydrophilic balance strongly informs degradation.

features.name: halogen_to_size_ratio
features.description: Halogen substituent density per molecular size unit.
features.expected_model_benefit: Density of halogens relative to size highlights heavily substituted small molecules.

features.name: topology_complexity_index
features.description: Topological complexity from V14, V15, V36, V37 descriptors.
features.expected_model_benefit: Combined topology metric for split efficiency.

features.name: high_v30_flag
features.description: Indicator that V30 exceeds the typical range (>20), capturing extreme values.
features.expected_model_benefit: Direct boolean split for outlier descriptor V30.

features.name: v17_v18_v22_shape_interaction
features.description: Multiplicative interaction of normalized shape descriptors V17, V18, V22.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures joint shape-index region that single features miss.

features.name: functional_diversity_score
features.description: Semantic count of distinct non-zero functional/substructure descriptors among V3-V11, V19-V26, V29, V32-V35, V38, V40, V41 indicating molecular diversity.
features.expected_model_benefit: Tree can split on diversity to distinguish simple vs complex molecules.

features.name: persistent_pollutant_likelihood
features.description: Heuristic ordinal score (0-4) judging persistence: high heavy-halogen count, high aromatic load, low polar group ratio, and large size jointly indicate likely persistent/non-degradable structure.
features.expected_model_benefit: Encodes domain prior into a single ordinal that trees can split cleanly.
